from pathlib import Path
from textual.app import ComposeResult, on
from textual.containers import Horizontal
from textual.widgets import DirectoryTree, TextArea, Header, Footer
from textual.widgets.directory_tree import FileSelected
from textual.app import App


class FileExplorerApp(App):
    BINDINGS = [("q", "quit", "Quit")]
    
    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        with Horizontal():
            yield DirectoryTree(Path.home())
            yield TextArea()
        yield Footer()
    
    @on(FileSelected)
    def handle_file_selected(self, message: FileSelected) -> None:
        try:
            content = message.path.read_text()
            text_area = self.query_one(TextArea)
            text_area.text = content
        except Exception:
            pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = FileExplorerApp()
    app.run()

        yield Header()
        with Horizontal():
